environment.description: Spring Boot service deployed on EC2 behind an Application Load Balancer with no path-based restrictions. The ALB forwards all traffic on port 8080 to the target group. Security group allows inbound from 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443 (ALB) and ALB-to-instance on 8080. No authentication middleware configured. The /api/v1/media/sessions and /api/v1/media/sessions/{id} endpoints are publicly accessible.

config.network: ALB public-facing, no WAF, SG allows 0.0.0.0/0:443
